sampling_focus_semantics: sampling_focus selects one validation quota only; it is not an AI label, scenario decision, permission, or ground truth and it must not remove alternative hypotheses

eligibility_contract.V2_CORE_OBJECTIVE_PROXY: MATURE_TREND_PULLBACK has at least one objective hypothesis and its route data sufficiency status is true
eligibility_contract.MACRO_COPY_OBJECTIVE_PROXY: MACRO_COPY_RESONANCE has at least one objective hypothesis and its route data sufficiency status is true
eligibility_contract.FRESH_Q1_OBJECTIVE_PROXY: FRESH_Q1_EXPANSION has at least one objective hypothesis and its route data sufficiency status is true
eligibility_contract.BEAR_REVERSAL_OBJECTIVE_PROXY: BEAR_REVERSAL_LEFT_RIGHT has at least one objective hypothesis and its route data sufficiency status is true
eligibility_contract.MACRO_DEFENSE_REMOVE_PROXY: parent_campaign_invalidated or macro_defense_alert is objectively true as of the review point
eligibility_contract.WAIT_POLICY_BOUNDARY: wait_boundary_reasons contains at least one frozen objective reason as of the review point

capacity_rule: Each stratum must have at least quota * (1 + reserve_block_count) eligible cases before allocation; global max flow must then fill all slots without reusing a review_id.
